# Issue #234 split verify() into one handler per node type on top of the
# verify_ctx_t context struct (#233). Issue #235 then split the 5,096-line
# tips.c along its four responsibilities: tips_xml.c (XML loading),
# tips_extract.c (pcap extraction + leaf evaluation), tips_eval.c
# (rule-instance lifecycle + verify() traversal) and tips_report.c
# (verdicts/history/reactions), leaving tips.c as the driver (engine state,
# memory/file helpers, init_sec_lib/init_options, analyse_incoming_packet).
# Issue #236 collapsed the repeated (pkt, curr_root, list_of_tuples, cause,
# packet time) argument bundles onto verify_ctx_t without touching control
# flow — analyse_incoming_packet grew by the three context initializers.
# Every function derived from verify() is <= 60 lines at nesting depth <= 4
# (they live in tips_eval.c).
#
# Issue #548 split the four functions that were still above the default
# gate (200 lines / depth 6) and are not derived from verify() —
# create_boolean_expression (tips_xml.c), compare_values and
# get_data_from_pcap (tips_extract.c), store_history (tips_report.c) — into
# static helpers: every function in these units is now within the gate.
